Name: Earthy Crops and Forage
Author: willowmods
Description:
[color=#999999][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/headers/44070_1774396346.jpg[/img][/color]

I find that the crops and forage really stand out when playing with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour, so this is just a very simple recolour mod attempting to apply DaisyNiko's palette to the vanilla artwork. 

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]There are no compatibility issues that I'm aware of, but please let me know if you come across any.[/color]
[color=#999999]I've set the edits from this mod to be applied early in the load order, meaning any other retexture or recolour mods you may have installed will override the changes made by this mod.[/color]

[size=4][b]Recom[/b][b]mende[/b][b]d mods[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [color=#999999]to edit mod configurations in-game.[/color]
[color=#999999][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] the reason I created this mod (though it's not required).[/color]
[color=#999999][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4908]Peachy Objects [/url]for some very pretty additional retextures. I use quite a few in my personal game, and have taken a lot of inspiration from it!![/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][b]Bugs or other input?[/b][/size][/color][color=#999999]
I've not yet had a lot of time to play with this mod beside bug testing, so I might make some minor edits to the recolouring if I feel it's needed when I do have time to play more, and am very open to feedback on this! [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]Thank you to [/color][color=#ffffff][b]ConcernedApe[/b][/color][color=#999999] for creating all the art and this wonderful game, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url] for making [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/peachitto]Peachitto[/url] for the banana sprite and for some of my colour choices.[/color]
